synthesizedFacts.fact: The 'Realistic Skin Texture style XL' model is a LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) designed for creating detailed and photorealistic skin textures in digital art.
The model can be combined with other styles such as 'Skin Tone Style XL' to enhance human skin color realism.
The model uses various base models and techniques such as SD1.5, Flux1D, and F1D to achieve its results.
